hero.title: Discover Your Campus Life at SRU
hero.subtitle: Campus life at SRU extends far beyond the classroom — diverse clubs, cultural and sports events, volunteer programs, and comprehensive support every step of the way.

cta.title: Become Part of Our University Community
cta.description: Campus life at SRU isn't just about studying — it's a complete experience that shapes your character and opens your future horizons.

clubs.title: Discover Your Passion — Join a Club
clubs.subtitle: The SRU campus hosts 40+ student clubs across diverse fields. Find a community that shares your interests.

list.name: Scientific Research Club
list.description: A platform for undergraduate and postgraduate students to collaborate on research projects and publish in scientific journals.

list.name: Languages & Translation Club
list.description: Learn new languages, practise translation, and connect with students worldwide in a fun educational environment.

list.name: Entrepreneurship Club
list.description: Develop entrepreneurial skills and build networks with founders and investors through workshops and competitions.

list.name: Medicine & Health Club
list.description: Brings together medical and health sciences students to share knowledge and organise health awareness campaigns on campus and in the community.

list.name: Football Club
list.description: The university team competes in the Saudi Universities League with distinguished results. Daily training under professional coaches.

list.name: Swimming & Fitness Club
list.description: Achieve complete physical fitness in our Olympic-size pool and fully-equipped gym with the latest facilities.

list.name: Tennis & Individual Sports Club
list.description: For tennis, badminton and athletics enthusiasts — modern courts and specialist coaches to take your game to the next level.

list.name: Theatre & Arts Club
list.description: Create, express, and inspire — a club uniting lovers of visual arts, theatre, and photography in an inspiring creative space.

list.name: Music & Nasheed Club
list.description: The Music Club brings together talented students for nasheed performances and purposeful music at university events.

list.name: Media & Production Club
list.description: Learn digital content creation, filming, editing, and broadcasting in a studio equipped with the latest technology.

list.name: Programming & Dev Club
list.description: For programmers and developers — hackathons, open-source projects, and workshops in the latest languages and technologies.

list.name: AI & Robotics Club
list.description: Explore the world of AI and learn to design and program robots in specialised labs with field experts.

volunteering.title: Giving Makes the Difference
volunteering.description: SRU believes in the student's role as an active community contributor. Through the Community Responsibility Department, our students participate in hundreds of volunteer initiatives each year serving the surrounding community.

initiatives.title: Voluntary Health Campaigns
initiatives.description: Free screenings and health awareness in neighbouring communities in partnership with the College of Medicine.

initiatives.title: Education & Literacy Programs
initiatives.description: Educational programs and literacy teaching for those in need in surrounding areas.

initiatives.title: Field Visits & Community Projects
initiatives.description: Visiting social welfare centres and implementing environmental and infrastructure development projects.

initiatives.title: New Student Mentoring Program
initiatives.description: Senior student volunteers help new students integrate and adapt to the university environment.

initiatives.title: Environment & Sustainability Initiatives
initiatives.description: Tree-planting drives, public area clean-up campaigns, and community awareness about environmental conservation.

events.title: Unforgettable Events Throughout the Year
events.subtitle: Participate in 100+ sports, cultural, and recreational events organised annually on and off campus.

sports_events.title: Inter-College Football Championship
sports_events.description: Annual tournament bringing together university college teams in fair competition with high sportsmanship.

sports_events.title: Annual University Swimming Championship
sports_events.description: University-level swimming competition at the Olympic pool — open to all students.

sports_events.title: University Sports Day
sports_events.description: An open day gathering students in team and individual games in a festive atmosphere with prizes and certificates.

student_support.title: We Are With You Every Step
student_support.subtitle: SRU's Student Support Centre provides comprehensive academic advising and psychological support services.

services.title: Academic Counselling
services.description: Specialist academic guidance to help you excel in your educational journey

items.label: Support for students with special circumstances

services.title: Psychological Counselling
services.description: A safe, confidential environment to support you emotionally throughout your university journey
